name: Item scaling: white items dropped by a level-scaled creature are lifted like green ones
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, DestinyWeaver.Scaling.Offset=3 and CoA.ItemScaling=1. "Squealer" Thornmantle 3229 is a level 5 creature that drops Squealer's Belt 4951 at 100%, authored at item level 4 and required level 1 with 45 armor, which this realm places at item level 3 and keeps at required level 1. A level 30 character with open-world scaling on fights it at level 27, 22 levels above its own, and item lifts round down to five-level steps, so the belt is a copy lifted by 20 levels. That lift is measured from the creature, so only the item it is added to moved: item level 23, required level 21, and more armor than the authored 45. With scaling off the same creature is fought at 5 and drops the belt itself. Client rendering of the copy is not tested.

steps.label: The scaled corpse holds a copy of Squealer's Belt
The copy is lifted to item level 23, twenty above the three this realm gives the belt
The copy carries more armor than the authored 45
The looted copy keeps item level 23
The unscaled corpse holds the belt itself
The unlifted belt keeps the item level this realm gives it, 3
